A1.justification: Both complete 35-page PDFs describe the same Aegis work. Text extraction and rendered-page comparison cover the main text, equations, figures, tables and Appendices A–E without material gaps.

before.justification: v5 reports original error-attribution experiments on Aegis-Bench and Who&When, ablations, and human label-validation results (Table 1; Appendices B and D).

after.justification: v6 retains the original benchmark experiments, ablations, human label-validation study and supplementary quantitative analyses.

M1.justification: The error-generation pipeline, SFT objective, hierarchical GRPO reward and DCL architecture and losses are identical (Sections 4–5; Appendix C).

E1.justification: Both retain the same six construction benchmarks, six MAS frameworks, Who&When evaluation and MAST-Data realism comparison (Sections 4 and 6; Appendix B).

E2.justification: Tables 1 and 8–10 and Appendix A retain identical comparator membership, including the foundation models and DCL variants. No comparison method is added, removed or replaced.

E3.justification: Test sampling, training/validation splits, attribution metrics, model configurations, training budgets and evaluation procedures are unchanged (Section 6; Appendices B, D and E).

E4.justification: The DCL ablations, CoT and epoch analyses, representation visualizations, case studies, label-fidelity study, distributional analyses and cross-benchmark correlations are all retained unchanged.

E5.justification: Both report the same three-seed DCL means and standard deviations (Table 10), annotation-agreement measures (Appendix B.3), and correlation p-values (Table 11). Statistical reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative findings are identical. For example, Table 1 retains average scores of 26.51 for Aegis-SFT and 18.41 for Aegis-GRPO; appendix results also match.

T1.justification: Section 3's formal definitions, Section 5's mathematical objectives and rewards, and Appendix C's equations and Algorithm 1 are unchanged.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction's contributions and conclusion retain identical claims about automated error generation, 9,533 trajectories, three learning paradigms and generalization to Who&When.

C2.justification: Interpretations of fine-tuning gains, overfitting, robustness and failure cases are unchanged. The conclusion retains the same limitations concerning the predefined error taxonomy and controlled injection plans.

D1.justification: Implementation details, hardware, hyperparameters, preprocessing, prompts and code/data release statements are unchanged. The added funding acknowledgment provides no new technical or reproducibility information.

R1.justification: Section 2 and the complete reference list are unchanged after matching entries shifted across pages 10–14. No cited work or research-positioning statement is added or removed.

P1.justification: v6 adds an Acknowledgments section after the conclusion, crediting National Science and Technology Major Project grant 2022ZD0114900, and updates the arXiv version/date stamp. Other wording and section organization are unchanged.

P2.justification: The acknowledgment causes limited layout and reference reflow on pages 10–14. Figures 1–7, Tables 1–11, Algorithm 1 and all appendix layouts remain identical.

improvement.justification: v6 adds funding attribution and updates the version stamp, with minor reference reflow. This improves administrative completeness, but the scientific content, supporting evidence, reproducibility details and substantive exposition are identical, leaving overall paper quality meaningfully unchanged.
